g.text: ON AIR v2.15 — front-frame wire routing
Replace part 01 only. Front 129 × 69 mm; rear housing, acrylic and mounting locations remain unchanged.
Front-view coordinates · section 5 mm behind the face
Acrylic hidden. For assembly from the rear, left and right appear reversed.
Blue: open cable loop + inward access · Amber: LED positions · Dashed: original 120 × 60 outline
Small glue anchors retain the wires.
Install and dress the harness before closing the optical stack
1. Measure insulation diameter: AWG specifies the copper, not the outside size. Flexible 24 AWG is easier to thread.
2. Lay the wires into the open channels around the bosses. Keep connectors and R1 in their original service bays.
3. Preserve DIN → DOUT order. Dress overlaps and bends in the open bays; tack wires down with small glue anchors.
4. Seat each LED on its original floor, emitter inward. Use small hot-glue anchors clear of pads and the light-emitting edge.
5. Fit the acrylic, backing and retainer. All seats and screws must close by hand without crushing or pinching wires.
